answer: A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 109 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. The beacon detector writes to ripple, and sonnet exposes every merge. Submissions that land within 209 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
